visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Five young women wearing coordinated blue and white athletic-style jackets, white skirts or black shorts, and sneakers stand in a V-formation formation against a plain white wall. The central woman is positioned slightly forward, and they all have their hands at their sides. The setting is a brightly lit indoor space with a concrete floor marked with yellow lines. (2) The group executes a synchronized dance routine characterized by rapid hand movements where they bring their hands towards their torsos and then rotate their arms outward. Every dancer maintains a joyful facial expression with wide smiles and engaged eyes. The central woman in black shorts and high boots leads the movement as they point towards the camera in unison with the musical beat. (3) As the choreography continues, three black question marks appear as a variety text overlay above the head of the woman on the far right. She tilts her head slightly in a staged look of confusion while the others maintain high-energy arm swings and rhythmic head tilts. The scene concludes with the entire group performing large-scale hand gestures and energetic torso shifts while remaining in their initial positions.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female vocal delivery of the Korean word 'Gwaenchana' begins the track, featuring a bright, airy timbre and a distinctive rising intonation. The BGM enters simultaneously with a sharp, electronic percussion strike and a high-frequency synth transient that establishes an immediate sense of high arousal and rhythmic energy. (2) The audio shifts into a driving, high-tempo K-pop arrangement with a steady BPM of approximately 128. A group of female voices performs a repetitive 'ding ding ding' melodic hook with high pitch and an extremely playful, animated tone. The electronic beat is dense, featuring crisp synthesizers and a punchy kick drum that maintains a consistent pulse. (3) The rhythmic musical bed continues unabated, but the vocal layer introduces a secondary, more aggressive shouting style with high arousal. These voices deliver rhythmic, chanted phrases with a sharp falling intonation, creating a high-energy contrast to the earlier playful singing while the electronic percussion remains the dominant spectral force.
